galleries.name: minimal.gallery
galleries.note: Minimal, type-led sites. The best one to start with

galleries.name: Site of Sites
galleries.note: Big, up-to-date gallery (600+ sites) with lots of personal portfolios. Filter by industry, type and style

galleries.name: Godly
galleries.note: Web design inspiration with live previews

galleries.name: Httpster
galleries.note: Curated sites, filterable by type and style

galleries.name: Mindsparkle Mag
galleries.note: A website of the day, with write-ups

fonts.name: ABC Dinamo
fonts.note: Really good grotesks, monos and serifs (Diatype, Favorit, Monument Grotesk…). Paid licences, with trial fonts for mockups

fonts.name: Fontshare
fonts.note: Indian Type Foundry's free fonts (Satoshi, General Sans, Clash Display, Cabinet Grotesk, Switzer, Erode). Free for commercial use, with a hosted CSS API. The closest free match to Dinamo

fonts.name: Velvetyne
fonts.note: French libre foundry. Experimental, characterful display type, all OFL

fonts.name: Collletttivo
fonts.note: Italian open-source type collective (Apfel Grotezk). Quirky grotesks

fonts.name: Uncut
fonts.note: Curated catalogue of contemporary free and libre typefaces. Good for browsing

fonts.name: Open Foundry
fonts.note: Hand-picked open-source fonts with nice specimens

fonts.name: Badass Libre Fonts by Womxn
fonts.note: Libre fonts by women and non-binary designers. Strong display faces

fonts.name: Tunera Type Foundry
fonts.note: Small libre foundry with expressive serifs and display faces

fonts.name: Google Fonts
fonts.note: What theme.mjs loads from. The good ones: Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Bricolage Grotesque, Space Grotesk, Geist, Geist Mono, Inter

fonts.name: Atipo Foundry
fonts.note: Pay what you want, including nothing

fonts.name: Pangram Pangram
fonts.note: Neue Montreal, Editorial New. Free trials for mockups only; commercial use needs a paid licence

tools.name: Space Type Generator
tools.note: Kinetic type in the browser: type on a path, ribbons, stretch and repeat, exported as video. Good for trying a type motion before building it with GSAP or p5.js

tools.name: GridType
tools.note: Draw a typeface on a modular grid and download it as a font. For headline lettering made of shapes

tools.name: Paper Shaders
tools.note: Zero-dependency WebGL shaders (mesh gradients, grain, dithering, liquid metal) as React components or GLSL. Tune them in the browser, then paste the props

tools.name: brik.space
tools.note: Describe a design tool and it builds one with its own controls (animation, 3D, type). For one-off generative pieces

tools.name: javii.tools
tools.note: Small mockup makers: chat bubbles, reviews, Instagram tags, stamps, charts. Exports transparent PNGs for case studies and social posts
